_descriptor_type: A type of descriptor. One of 'simulation', 'trace', and 'perf'.
_workload_manager: manual: run each exp scenario with all the simpoints at a time, slurm: Slurm schedules simulations based on its policy
_root_dir: Root directory mounted into the docker container home, for instance, $tmp_dir as a root home directory
_application_dir: The path to the benchmark application directory used for tracing or simulation. This directory replaces ISO-based setups by mounting a local application folder (e.g., SPEC CPU2017) into the container during image build or runtime.
_scarab_path: The path to the scarab repository that contains the scarab binary used to run the experiment.
_traces_dir: A directory to place the collected traces.
_trace_name: The name of the tracing. scarab-infra will create a new folder named containing in-progress collected simpoints/traces in the <ROOT_DIR>/traces/<trace_name> directory. Only successfully collected simpoints and traces will be copied to <TRACE_DIR> and the corresponding information for future simulations will be stored in workloads/workloads_db.json.
_disabled_trace_configurations: JSON은 주석을 지원하지 않아서, 현재 실행하면 실패하는 workload는 이 필드에 비활성 상태로 보관한다.

_trace_configurations: A list of [workload, image_name, suite, subsuite, environment variables, binary (server) command, client command, trace_type, clustering_k, slurm_options (optional, ignored in for manual runner)]. 'env_vars' is list of environment variables required to be set to run 'binary_cmd' and 'client_bincmd'. 'trace_type' is 'cluster_then_trace' by default (collect fingerprints, do simpoint clustering, then trace). Set 'trace_then_cluster' to do post processing (trace, collect fingerprints, then do simpoint clustering). Set 'iterative_trace ' do tracing on a timestep basis. maxk for clustering will be calculated as the square root of the number of segments if 'clustering_k' is not provided. The workload information will be automatically written to scarab-infra/workloads/workload_db.json when the trace is successfully collected with simpoints. Provide environment variables, binary command, and client binary command if available by manually figuring out them. The slurm_options field is used to provide arguments to all slurm commands (ignored for manual runner). An empty string can be used if you do not wish to set any slurm options. Default behaviour is depenent on your slurm cluster configuration. The only option set by the infrastructure is -c 1 (use 1 core) for all simpoint jobs. Options can be found here: https://slurm.schedmd.com/sbatch.html
